content_sections.heading: JEPC Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Candidates must possess the educational qualifications and relevant experience prescribed for the post. Different positions require qualifications in management, communication, computer science, finance, accounting, education or civil engineering. Qualification: Master's degree in Management, HR Management or Personnel Management from a recognized institution with the prescribed minimum marks. Experience: Minimum 5 years of relevant experience in HR management. Key Responsibilities: Human resource planning, personnel management, recruitment support, employee training, performance monitoring and HR database management. Qualification: Master's degree in Mass Communication, Journalism or another specified communication-related discipline with the prescribed minimum marks. Experience: Minimum 5 years of relevant experience in media handling, communications, public relations, publications or content development. Key Responsibilities: Public communication, media coordination, publications, awareness campaigns, community mobilization and programme communication. Qualification: Graduate qualification in Computer Science, IT, B.Tech., B.E. or another specified technical discipline. Experience: Minimum 5 years of relevant experience in the development and implementation of digital education or ICT solutions. Key Responsibilities: Digital education initiatives, ICT implementation, technology monitoring and coordination with educational institutions. Qualification: Master's degree in Humanities, Social Sciences, Education or another specified discipline with the prescribed minimum marks. Experience: Minimum 5 years of relevant experience in education or child-focused development programmes. Key Responsibilities: Monitoring residential schools, KGBV programmes, out-of-school children initiatives, educational planning and programme implementation. Qualification: Master's degree in Finance, Commerce, Accounts, CA, ICWA, CS or a specified management-related qualification with the prescribed minimum marks. Experience: Minimum 5 years of relevant experience in tendering, procurement, purchase or financial management. Key Responsibilities: Procurement planning, purchase management, tendering, compliance and coordination of procurement activities. Qualification: Master's degree in a recognized discipline with the prescribed minimum marks. Experience: Minimum 3 years of relevant experience in government or development-sector programme implementation. Key Responsibilities: District-level programme management, planning, implementation, monitoring, evaluation and coordination. Qualification: Bachelor's degree in a recognized discipline with the prescribed minimum marks. Experience: Minimum 2 years of relevant experience in education, development or programme implementation. Key Responsibilities: Programme planning, field monitoring, data analysis, reporting, coordination and support for district-level education activities. content_sections.heading: JEPC Recruitment 2026 Salary and Allowances
content_sections.text: The selected candidates will receive consolidated monthly remuneration according to their posts. The advertised salary ranges from Rs. 26,923 to Rs. 66,251 per month. Annual increment of 3%, subject to satisfactory performance. Possible revision of basic monthly honorarium as decided by the JEPC State Executive Committee. Applicable project, house rent, medical and conveyance allowances. Retiral benefits as applicable under the relevant government and JEPC provisions.

content_sections.heading: JEPC Recruitment 2026 Application Fee
content_sections.text: Payment Mode: Credit Card, Debit Card, Net Banking or UPI through the JEPC application portal after submitting the application form. The application processing fee is non-refundable. Payment through cash, IPO or demand draft is not accepted.

content_sections.heading: JEPC Recruitment 2026 Selection Process
content_sections.text: The shortlisting of candidates for interview will follow the applicable category-wise qualifying criteria. The recruitment notice also provides rules for awarding work experience marks to eligible candidates.

content_sections.heading: JEPC Recruitment 2026 Written Exam Pattern
content_sections.text: Written Test Duration: 3 hours. The examination is described as an MCQ/OMR-based test. Maximum marks: 20 Duration: 1 hour Questions are based on the functional requirements of the relevant post category. The final examination instructions and applicability of the computer-based assessment should be confirmed through the official JEPC recruitment portal.

content_sections.heading: JEPC Recruitment 2026 Contract Period
content_sections.text: The advertised appointments are on a short-term contractual basis. The initial contract period is one year and may be extended based on satisfactory performance and programme requirements. JEPC also provides for annual performance assessment for continuation or extension of the contract. Appointment does not, by itself, establish permanent government employment.

content_sections.heading: JEPC Recruitment 2026 Reservation and Qualification Relaxation
content_sections.text: Reservation will be governed by the applicable Jharkhand Government rules. Candidates claiming reservation benefits must possess the required certificates in the prescribed format.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply Online for JEPC Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Important Instructions: Only one application is permitted per candidate. Applications received after the prescribed deadline will not be accepted. Candidates should regularly check the official JEPC website for recruitment updates.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are listed in JEPC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The supplied JEPC advertisement lists 106 vacancies across 14 post categories, including management, IT, accounts and Junior Engineer positions.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for JEPC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The draft recruitment advertisement specifies 31 October 2026 at 5:00 PM as the last date for online application. Candidates should confirm the final deadline on the official JEPC website.

faq.question: Q3. What qualifications are required for JEPC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Educational requirements vary by post and include relevant graduate degrees, postgraduate degrees, engineering qualifications, diploma qualifications and professional accounting qualifications. Candidates must satisfy the requirements for the post they choose.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary for JEPC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The advertised consolidated monthly remuneration ranges from Rs. 26,923 to Rs. 66,251 depending on the post. Finance Controller carries the highest listed monthly remuneration of Rs. 66,251.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for JEPC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The minimum age is 21 years. The maximum age is 35 years for UR/EWS candidates, 37 years for BC-I/BC-II candidates, 38 years for women in the specified categories and 40 years for SC/ST candidates. Additional relaxation applies to eligible PwBD candidates.

faq.question: Q6. What is the JEPC Recruitment 2026 application fee?
faq.answer: The application fee is Rs. 1,000 or Rs. 500 depending on the post group. Eligible SC/ST candidates are required to pay 50% of the applicable post-wise fee, subject to the notification conditions.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for JEPC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The selection framework consists of written test evaluation, technical proficiency, personal interview, academic qualification and work experience. The total merit assessment is 200 marks.

faq.question: Q8. How many Junior Engineer vacancies are available?
faq.answer: The advertisement lists 32 Junior Engineer (Civil Works) vacancies at the block level, with consolidated monthly remuneration of Rs. 26,923.

faq.question: Q9. Can Civil Engineering diploma holders apply for JEPC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Yes. The Junior Engineer (Civil Works) position specifies a Diploma in Civil Engineering from a recognized institution with a minimum of 55% marks, subject to the other recruitment conditions.

faq.question: Q10. s JEPC Recruitment 2026 permanent or contractual?
faq.answer: The advertised appointments are on a short-term contractual basis. The initial contract period is one year, with possible extension based on satisfactory performance and programme requirements.
